PROJECT_SETTINGS.TITLE: Project Settings - {{name}}
PROJECT_SETTINGS.RULE1_DESC: When enabled, verifies that the H1 heading in each Markdown file matches the filename and automatically adds YAML frontmatter to markdown files. This helps maintain consistency between file names and document titles.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.RULE1_NOTE: Note: This feature should be disabled when using GitHub Compatible Mode, as GitHub doesn't recognize MdExplorer's custom YAML frontmatter format.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.GITHUB_MODE_DESC: When enabled, uses GitHub-compatible markdown rendering (no PlantUML, interactive emoji, etc.). Disable for full MdExplorer features when working in a team environment.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.LINK_INDEXING_DESC: When enabled, MdExplorer indexes all links inside markdown files to track cross-references and automatically recalculate paths when files are moved or renamed.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.LINK_INDEXING_NOTE: Note: Disabling this setting improves performance on large projects but removes link reference tracking and automatic link recalculation on file move/rename. Changes take effect on next project reload.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.STICKY_SCROLL_DESC: When enabled, parent folders remain visible at the top of the file tree while scrolling — similar to VS Code's file explorer behavior.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.PLANTUML_KEEP_ORIGINAL: Keep PlantUML original colors in dark mode
PROJECT_SETTINGS.PLANTUML_KEEP_ORIGINAL_DESC: When enabled, PlantUML diagrams render in their original colors even when dark mode is active, for better readability. The per-diagram light/dark toggle button remains available to override on a single diagram.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.COPILOT_CLI_AUTO_SELECT: Use Copilot CLI automatically when available
PROJECT_SETTINGS.COPILOT_CLI_AUTO_SELECT_DESC: When enabled and Copilot CLI is installed on this machine, the AI chat will automatically use Copilot CLI as the model for this project. If Copilot CLI is not installed, the chat stays disabled until you pick a different model from the model settings.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.EXCLUDE_SUBMODULES: Exclude git submodules from change detection
PROJECT_SETTINGS.EXCLUDE_SUBMODULES_DESC: When enabled, changes inside git submodules are ignored: the submodule never appears in the toolbar change list and never lights up the commit button. Disable it for this project if you want to track and commit submodule changes from MdExplorer.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.IDE_SELECT_DESC: Select which IDE should be used to open files from the toolbar:
PROJECT_SETTINGS.IDE_INFO: IDE settings are specific to this project and saved in the database. Changes take effect immediately when opening files from the toolbar.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.RAG_DESC: When enabled, MdExplorer generates semantic embeddings for all markdown files in the project. This allows AI-powered semantic search via the MCP server and the built-in AI chat.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.RAG_INCREMENTAL: Embeddings are generated incrementally: only changed files are re-processed.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.FORCE_REINDEX_DESC: Force Reindex: Clears all existing chunks and runs a full re-indexing with embedding generation.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.CLEAR_INDEX_DESC: Clear Index: Deletes all indexed chunks without re-indexing.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.NO_EMBEDDING_MODEL: No embedding model is installed. Go to Settings > Embedding to manage embedding models.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.NO_APPS: No apps configured for this project.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.NO_APPS_HINT: Use "Add App from Catalog" to get started.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.DELETE_RAG_CONFIRM: This will delete all indexed RAG chunks. Continue?
PROJECT_SETTINGS.KG_ENABLE: Enable Neo4j knowledge graph for this project
PROJECT_SETTINGS.KG_ENABLE_DESC: When enabled, .mde-doc/*.kg.md payloads are ingested into a Neo4j instance, giving the AI a queryable concept graph via MCP. The graph is in addition to (not a replacement for) the file-link graph already available under "Knowledge Graph" in the toolbar.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.KG_PASSWORD_HINT_KEEP: Leave blank to keep the currently stored password
PROJECT_SETTINGS.KG_RESET_CONFIRM: This will WIPE all knowledge-graph nodes for this project from Neo4j and force a full re-sync on next operation. Continue?
PROJECT_SETTINGS.KG_RESET_DONE: Reset complete. Click "Sync all aggregates" to repopulate.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.FUSEKI_ENABLE: Enable Fuseki (RDF triplestore) for this project
PROJECT_SETTINGS.FUSEKI_ENABLE_DESC: When enabled, .kg.ttl / .kg.ru payloads are ingested into a Fuseki dataset, giving the AI a SPARQL-queryable graph. Independent from the Neo4j integration; the two can coexist.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.FUSEKI_DATASET_HINT: URL-safe name. One dataset per MDE project — auto-sanitized if needed.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.FUSEKI_AUTH_OPTIONAL: optional — leave blank if Fuseki runs without auth
PROJECT_SETTINGS.FUSEKI_TEST_DATASET_MISSING: Server reachable but dataset "{{dataset}}" doesn't exist. Click "Create dataset" to provision it.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.ATLASSIAN_ENABLE: Enable the Atlassian integration for this project
PROJECT_SETTINGS.ATLASSIAN_ENABLE_DESC: When enabled, the AI can triage your Jira issues and draft an implementation plan as markdown. Read-only on Jira; only local files are written.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.ATLASSIAN_PROJECT_KEYS_HINT: Comma-separated, e.g. BCO, OFELIA. Shared with the team.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.CONFLUENCE_SPACE_KEYS_HINT: Space keys (not names), e.g. DEV, ARCH. The first one is the default space where the AI publishes new pages; all of them hint the scope for AI searches. Shared with the team.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL_HINT: Leave empty: Confluence is derived as {site}/wiki from the Jira base URL above. Set it only if Confluence is on a different site.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.ATLASSIAN_SHARED_HINT: Shared — saved in .development.yml and committed with the repo.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.ATLASSIAN_TOKEN_HINT: Personal — stored encrypted on your machine, never committed. Create a read-only scoped token at id.atlassian.com.
PROJECT_SETTINGS.ATLASSIAN_TOKEN_KEEP: Leave blank to keep the saved token
PROJECT_SETTINGS.REINDEX_PROJECT_DESC: Forces a full reindex of links, full-text search and embeddings, ignoring the incremental index. Use it if the index looks inconsistent.
